Ogg demuxer (OggReader) for Vorbis streams.

Ports symphonia-format-ogg (page/physical/logical layers, Vorbis mapping): OggS pages with MPEG-2 CRC-32 verification, segment tables, packet assembly across pages (continued packets), serial demultiplexing, Vorbis ident/comment/setup handling, per-packet duration/discard computation, granule chaining, binary-search seek. Deviations: in-memory with an eager packet index (no streaming or seekback buffers); chained Ogg bitstreams are rejected; non-Vorbis serials are skipped (Opus/FLAC/Theora named if they are the only streams).
